paper_title: X-ray Searches for Axions from Super Star Clusters
notes: Joint 95% power-constrained upper limit (red curve) combining Quintuplet and Wd1 super-star-cluster NuSTAR analyses, from Fig. 3 (Plots/combined_limit_Wd1.pdf in the e-print), extracted from the vector PDF using log-log tick calibration (Wd1 bottom panel; the Quintuplet top-panel red curve is identical). Paper headline: g_agamma <~ 3.6e-12 GeV^-1 for m_a <~ 5e-11 eV; my low-mass plateau reads 3.7e-12 (~3% calibration offset). The dip near m_a~2e-11 eV is a genuine feature of the power-constrained limit. Not a dark-matter search, so no density dependence. This is an X-ray helioscope-like/Primakoff search on axions produced in and converted near super star clusters; the axion is assumed massless (m_a << 10^-11 eV) for the conversion probability at low masses, with the limit weakening above ~5e-11 eV.
